result.summary: The page looks mostly intact. The only notable visual issue is the promo banner’s main heading, which is very light and low-contrast against the pale green background.

issues.description: The promo heading “3 free deliveries for you” is a very light, low-contrast color on the pale mint-green banner, so it is hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the heading (or increase its contrast against the banner) so it meets readable contrast standards.
